contract: ../HARDENING.md and ../../PHASE-5.md — free local workflows, bounded offline data and explicit monitoring/commands.

accessibility.evidence: 73 scoped layout checks include labelled keyboard focus, reduced motion, 44px controls and full hit-tested action reachability. Not a full WCAG or screen-reader certification.

responsive.evidence: All eight new panels tested at desktop/phone/landscape. Mobile scrollport clears task navigation and final controls remain reachable.

loading.evidence: Region/watchlist/command controller and rendered tests exercise pending/disabled/cancelled states.

empty.evidence: Region preview and watch creation start empty without acquisition; screenshots and intercepted startup checks.

error.evidence: Tampered offline bytes rejected before import; failed saves, expired leases and native receiver regressions covered.

partial.evidence: Unknown building heights remain null; source/coverage limitations shown. Watch source partial/cooldown states covered.

success.evidence: commands-browser-checks.json covers ten explicit command checks; hardening-stress.json covers repeated real owner switching. Offline functional results are separately recorded in offline-checks.json.

permission.reason: No new accounts, paid providers or OS notification permissions. Local watch starts and command runs are explicit.

renderedEvidence.observation: Explicit validated action preview uses the standard single inspector and retained app navigation.
Phone region admission remains scrollable, with visible keyboard focus and reachable controls.
Short-screen inspector uses the existing sheet scroller; source controls remain available.
